nodes.name: Quota Status API
nodes.notes: Public read-only endpoint for displaying the current daily usage limits.

nodes.name: Extract & Validate Client IP
nodes.notes: Extracts and validates IPv4/IPv6 addresses from the expected reverse-proxy headers.

nodes.notes: Prevents quota lookup when the client IP address is invalid.

nodes.name: Get Daily Recipe Quota
nodes.notes: Reads the current quota counters without reserving an AI generation slot.

nodes.notes: Returns the frontend contract for the remaining per-IP and global recipe quotas.

nodes.notes: Returns a controlled error instead of exposing an incorrect quota status.
